label: defines
definition: A relation that holds between an environmental measurement axis (or condition) and an operationally-defined phenotype variable; asserts that the subject axis is the input dimension along which the object trait is parameterized (e.g. "external pH axis defines pH phenotype with numerical limits").
traits_addressed: covers 14 causal-graph edges across delta/range/optimum phenotype graphs for pH, salinity, NaCl concentration, oxygen, and temperature
observations: operationally-definitional relation; no clean RO/Biolink home (biolink:has_phenotype is the wrong direction; biolink:related_to is too weak); distinct from `selects for` (METPO:2007401) which is evolutionary, not definitional
